scope: Retrospective frozen-prediction dual-reference diagnostic, not independent physical truth or model selection. New comparator outcomes already exist; no refit, residual filtering, offset, time shifts or final data.
matching: Reuse exact (window_id, integer nanosecond endpoint) source joins; independently rebuild from original source records and check target/age and saved row identities. No nearest-time/interpolation/imputation.
populations: Every fitting group/recording/window plus pooled; full all matched, fixed historical HGB-accepted common matched cohort, and each model own admitted matched endpoints with separate denominators. Empty and missing comparisons remain explicit.
admission: Existing endpoint source/peer/clock checks; IMU models use fixed nominal deadband history+endpoint freshness. New Huber/ExtraTrees masks computed from frozen predictions, same peer/source/currentIMU state and inclusive1m/s. No reference error used for admission. These are endpoint eligibilities, not request-time availability or live capability grants.
interpretation: Two recorded references may share ancestry and errors. Keep primary unchanged; OBD is not certified independent truth or physical witness. Common-cohort rankings distinguished from each-model-admitted results. Earlier HGB discrepancy remains retained even if another frozen model has different outcome.
